subject: Insurance
title: The Beirut Port Explosion
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Beirut Port Explosion.

hook.text: In 2020, 2,750 tons of ammonium nitrate exploded in Beirut's port, killing 218 people.

buildup.text: The chemicals had been stored unsafely for six years. Officials knew but did nothing. The negligence was systemic.

climax.text: Beirut showed how government negligence creates insured disasters.

punchline.text: Six years of negligence, 218 dead. Government failure became an insurance bill.

quiz.question: What caused the Beirut port explosion?
options: Years of unsafe ammonium nitrate storage due to government negligence
